cloud.title: Cloud Library
cloud.server_none: No servers measured yet. Start a cloud game once and akira measures the available datacenters during launch, then you can pick the lowest-ping one here.
cloud.add_game_body: You don't own {} yet. Add it to your PlayStation library (buy or claim it from the PS Store) and it becomes streamable here. Cloud can't stream a title your account doesn't own.
cloud.language_caveat: A language only reaches you on a datacenter that serves it. Gaikai ignores one that no datacenter in reach offers, and says nothing. If the game keeps its old language, pick a matching server from the Server menu.
cloud.card_none: No cloud titles for this account
cloud.empty_none_title: No cloud games on this account

cloud.status_no_profile_detail: Choose a profile before opening cloud streaming.

cloud.status_checking_detail: Refreshing your cloud catalog and access state.
cloud.status_ready_detail: Open your catalog and start a stream straight from Akira.
cloud.status_relink_detail: Your stored session expired. Pair again with the Companion app to restore owned titles.
cloud.status_fallback_detail: PlayStation has no cloud storefront for this account's region, so this list comes from the public catalog. Which titles will actually stream has not been checked.
cloud.status_empty_detail: We didn't find any launchable cloud titles for this profile.
cloud.status_error_detail: Akira couldn't load the cloud catalog right now.
cloud.launch_not_enabled: This profile can't start cloud sessions yet. Check that cloud streaming is enabled on the account.
cloud.launch_ps_plus: Cloud streaming needs a PlayStation Plus tier that includes game streaming.
cloud.launch_privacy: This account isn't fully set up for PlayStation cloud streaming. PlayStation still needs these completed:
cloud.launch_privacy_action: Set them in the PS App or at playstation.com (Account settings), then try again.
cloud.launch_network: Akira couldn't reach PlayStation's cloud service. Check your connection and try again.
cloud.launch_busy: PlayStation didn't hand out a streaming slot in time. Try again in a moment.
cloud.launch_failed: Akira couldn't start the cloud stream.

settings.theme_restart: You must restart to apply this theme.
settings.discovery_subnets_hint: Add a subnet (/24 to /32) to find consoles on another subnet; Akira sweeps it by unicast. On a bigger network (e.g. a /16)? Enter just the /24 your console is on.
settings.subnet_invalid: Enter a /24 to /32 subnet, e.g. 192.168.50.0/24. For a bigger range, use the /24 the console is on.
settings.language_desc: Override display language. Requires app restart.
settings.local_network_desc: Settings for local network connections (higher bitrate may cause issues)
settings.remote_play_desc: Settings for remote connections (higher bitrate may cause issues)
settings.bitrate: Target Bitrate (ceiling, actual may be lower)
settings.analog_triggers_degraded: Analog triggers stopped - using digital ZL/ZR
settings.enable_dithering_desc: Reduces color banding on smooth gradients by adding subtle noise
settings.dithering_strength_desc: Higher values reduce banding more aggressively but may introduce visible noise (1-10)
settings.thread_affinity_desc: Pin threads to specific CPU cores for better performance. Requires app restart.
settings.holepunch_retry_desc: Automatically retry holepunch up to 4 times with increasing delays (3s, 6s, 9s)
settings.request_idr_desc: Request keyframe when frame recovery fails. Improves recovery but may cause brief freezes.
settings.packet_loss_max_desc: Limits reported packet loss to server. Lower values prevent quality degradation but may cause buffer issues on bad networks.
settings.unlock_bitrate_max_desc: Enables higher bitrate limits (720p: 25000, 1080p: 30000) with 5000 minimum
settings.ipc_stats_desc: Expose stats over IPC for consumption by a sysmodule. Do not use, developer only
settings.port_guessing_desc: Guess nearby ports for NAT traversal. Helps on mobile hotspots and port-rewriting NATs.
settings.port_guess_count_desc: Number of ports to advertise to the console (max 75)
settings.probe_socket_count_desc: Number of local sockets to open for NAT probing (max 250)
settings.auto_reconnect_desc: Automatically reconnect to the last session when resuming from sleep or returning from the home menu
settings.file_logging_desc: Save logs to SD card (/switch/akira/logs/). Requires app restart.
settings.lwip_log_desc: Enable verbose lwIP relay logging (very spammy during streaming)
settings.wireguard_log_desc: Enable WireGuard library logging (handshakes, keepalives, packet stats)
settings.render_log_desc: Enable renderer logging (draw calls, texture bindings, stats overlay)
settings.chiaki_log_desc: Enable chiaki library logging during streaming (CTRL, heartbeats, etc.)
settings.discovery_log_desc: Enable verbose discovery logging (host discovery broadcasts, responses)
settings.ffmpeg_log_desc: Enable FFmpeg decoder logging (errors, warnings, codec info)
